primary_math_review: Let q be the exposed height of Q. The 45-degree fold consumes a 4 by 4 elbow of strip length 4, so x+4+q=13. Since P=4x and Q=4q with P=2Q, x=2q and 3q=9: q=3,x=6 uniquely. Color is an annotation, not an equality or an extra constraint.
